from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path

p = json.loads(Path(\"project/recovery-inventory.json\").read_text())
r = p[\"retained_sample\"]
b = bytes.fromhex(r[\"value_hex\"])
pos = 5

def avro_long():
    global pos
    n = shift = 0
    while True:
        if pos >= len(b):
            raise ValueError(\"truncated value\")
        c = b[pos]
        pos += 1
        n |= (c & 127) << shift
        if not c & 128:
            return (n >> 1) "'^ -(n & 1)
        shift += 7

def avro_string():
    global pos
    n = avro_long()
    if n < 0 or pos + n > len(b):
        raise ValueError("invalid string length")
    s = b[pos:pos+n].decode("utf-8")
    pos += n
    return s

account = avro_string()
currency = avro_string()
amount = avro_long()
assert b[0] == 0
assert int.from_bytes(b[1:5], "big") == 42
